Implemented and verified the cache-only simulator optimization. All timings below are simulated predictions from cached L1 rows, not measured serving performance.

**Diagnosis:** `unified.qk_norm` was the largest redundant-work scope. Its `q_input_copy` and `k_input_copy` elementwise leaves copied strided Q/K views into contiguous buffers, but both had `necessary_gpu_s=0` and empty semantics in the necessary-work map (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`, `pred.casev1.optimality-kernel-ladder`).

| Scope | R0 measured | R5 hardware | R6 segmented | R7 fused | Leaves |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Before | 0.00047138 | 0.00008876849537500001 | 0.000000001792 | 0.000000001792 | `q_input_copy`, `q_norm`, `k_input_copy`, `k_norm` |
| After | 0.00027274799999999996 | 0.0000443842525 | 0.000000001792 | 0.000000001792 | `q_norm`, `k_norm` |

The source reports are [baseline scope](</workspace/logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_label_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_head_e6287c8359c2.json>) and [after scope](</workspace/logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_label_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_head_e070601a37dd.json>). The remaining norm leaves and their inputs are retained in the exact Analyzer cost trees (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`, `pred.casev1.operationv0.cost-tree`).

**Fix:** In [qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/arch/qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs:15), set `NORM_SUPPORTS_STRIDED` to `true`. The existing derived `copies_required()` logic then omits both copies while preserving the strided Q/K layout, `q_norm`, `k_norm`, head multipliers, and all other computation. The location map removes only the two obsolete empty-semantic entries in [qwen3_dense_vllm_before_unified.json](/workspace/model/work/location_maps/qwen3_dense_vllm_before_unified.json:9). [timing_predict.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/timing_predict.rs:243) now keeps JIT disabled so cache misses error instead of profiling.

Both baseline and after predictions completed with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""`, no `--profile`, and the warm `profiling/profile.db`; its size and mtime remained unchanged. After case totals are 3.952183246612549 ms and 1.7123689651489258 ms (`pred.overview`). Targeted Rust tests, `cargo check -p simulator --lib`, and `git diff --check` passed.

judge.reasoning: The agent identified the same redundant copies of strided Q/K views before q_norm and k_norm. Enabling strided RMSNorm support removes both copies while preserving q_norm and k_norm, matching the ground-truth fix's effect.
